title: Police Surprise Disorderly Woman as Elevator Opens
description:
► Sonoran Desert Institute 
Learn more today at https://www.sdi.edu/code-blue-cam/  

In December 2022, a La Crosse police officer responded to a trouble with party call at a parking ramp. A 30-year-old female allegedly charged and screamed at a caller in an elevator. The officer soon located her inside the elevator, but she refused to speak and tried to close the door. Despite attempts to calm her, she continued screaming and actively resisted. 

► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
